verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents an official first-party MCP server, confirmed by the probe of its /mcp docs page, that lets AI assistants and autonomous agents manage company finances. Documented tools cover spend queries and CSV export, card issuance and limits, reimbursements, and vendor bill pay. Missing for 10: documented connection and setup details (endpoint/transport and how agents authenticate to the MCP server), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting.
